current.service_desc: TNT is a multi-tenant, cloud-hosted (SaaS) platform for continuous security testing and compliance management. Core capabilities: (1) automated, authorized penetration testing and adversary emulation against customer-designated in-scope targets; (2) asset discovery and inventory with vulnerability aggregation and risk scoring; (3) governance, risk, and compliance monitoring that maps findings and evidence to frameworks such as NIST SP 800-53, PCI DSS, HIPAA, CIS Controls, and SOC 2 and reports control gaps with remediation guidance; and (4) security reporting and dashboards. An optional lightweight TNT endpoint sensor forwards host security telemetry to the platform's cloud analysis services for continuous analysis and threat hunting. The TNT Business Resilience Platform also integrates Agger ransomware protection capabilities, including endpoint-based behavioral detection, prevention, and response. Applicable cloud services supporting these capabilities are incorporated into the TNT service architecture and FedRAMP assessment scope. Automated assessment and analysis are performed by AI agents operating under human supervision.
